bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (CSSearchableIndex, CSSearchableItem, CSSearchableItemAttributeSet, IndexError, LocalizedString, Person, UserActivity), springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs (per-app on-disk index and search), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (Search panel, Documents section), springboard/proto/src/quicksearch.rs (wire messages)
summary: BifrOSt covers the core indexing path: an app can add, replace and delete its own searchable items, the shell keeps a bounded per-app index, and the system Search panel lists the items under Documents. The SDK now refuses items with an empty, too long or mismatched identifier and reports them with error codes, and folds custom values, persons and localized titles into the searchable text. It does not cover app-side queries and suggestions, index extensions and delegates, index descriptions, typed person or custom attributes in the panel, shell-side error reporting, or the Foundation models search tool.

gaps: No app-facing query API (CSSearchQuery, CSUserQuery) and no suggestions, so apps cannot search their own index or build a search field on it.
No index client delegate and no index extensions for on-demand regeneration (CSSearchableIndexDelegate, CSIndexExtensionRequestHandler, CSImportExtension).
The shell reports no completion or failure for indexing, and search queries have no error codes; IndexError covers only refusals the SDK makes before sending.
The wire has no typed fields for custom attribute keys, person records or localized strings; they are folded into keywords, so the Search panel cannot show them as Apple's attributes do.
No Foundation models search tool (SpotlightSearchTool and its pipeline types), so indexed content cannot be given to the on-device assistant as context.
No index descriptions or protection classes; the shell index is a single JSON file per app with oldest-first eviction at 1000 items.
